content:
I'll use this thread to track the Selmer group part of the effort to get a proof of the Mordell-Weil Theorem for ellitpic curves into Mathlib. This will be a sequence of PRs containing code upstreamed from EllipticCurves.

The first PR is #44614; it introduces a name for the group of classes of units mod nth powers in a commutative monoid, which is the type of group these Selmer groups live in.
I remember seeing a PR by Fabrizio on doing something for S-integers. Is this relevant to what you'll be PRing?
Do you mean #40848 ? I don't think it's immediately relevant, but I will (tell Claude to) keep an eye on in-flight PRs when preparing the next PRs in this direction. @Fabrizio Barroero
